हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Yash and Nandini’s love ended when she, hiding her cancer, faked an affair with Rahul. Heartbroken, Yash took over his father’s company. A year later, they crossed paths again, but his fiancée and Rahul conspired against Nandini. Yash uncovered the truth, rescued her, and she survived after surgery
